svg.aria-label: Two analytically calculated transmission mechanisms. Left: gradient multiplier in a scalar linear chain, on a logarithmic axis. Right: retained state fraction with a fixed forget gate and no new writing. These panels isolate repeated multiplication and the direct cell pathway.
